Dear [Admissions Committee/Recruiting Team],  

As a direct manager at CyberShield Technologies, I have collaborated closely with Jakub Novak over the past three years. His academic background in computer science, combined with his hands-on experience in cybersecurity, has made him an invaluable asset to our team. Jakub’s daily contributions to our security infrastructure and his collaborative approach have significantly enhanced our operational efficiency.  

Jakub’s technical expertise spans multiple critical areas. His proficiency in Go and Python has enabled him to develop robust, secure systems that underpin our cybersecurity framework. He has led the design and implementation of REST APIs that integrate seamlessly with third-party security tools, enhancing our threat detection capabilities. Additionally, his work with React has resulted in user-friendly dashboards that provide real-time insights into system vulnerabilities, improving our response times.  

One notable project involved Jakub’s initiative to automate security audits using Python scripts, which reduced manual workload by 40% and improved accuracy. He also spearheaded the development of a secure authentication module in Go, which addressed a critical vulnerability and enhanced our system’s resilience. His ability to troubleshoot complex issues under pressure, such as resolving a zero-day exploit in under 24 hours, underscores his technical depth and dedication.  

Jakub’s combination of technical skill, problem-solving acumen, and collaborative spirit makes him an exceptional candidate. His contributions have not only strengthened our cybersecurity infrastructure but also fostered a culture of innovation and reliability within the team.  

Sincerely,  
[Your Full Name]  
[Your Title]
